questions.subject: SOCIOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: Apply social class to a study of class inequality.

stimulus.body: In 2007 a study of 450 retirees in West Africa found 65% identified as working class, while 33% identified as upper class.

questions.stem: What is the point gap in the 2007 Africa class inequality survey?
questions.explanation: Subtracting 33 percent from 65 percent gives 32 percentage points, the gap reported in the 2007 data from West Africa between the two shares.
questions.hint: Look past the numbers to the relationship they describe.
